item.title: Tunis Desk – Sunday 18 October 2026
item.description: Budget 2027: state spending, Central Bank financing and a first sukuk; Unions, lawyers and rights groups march in Tunis; Oil prices and the call for a supplementary budget; Kais Saied in Bizerte for Evacuation Day; Sugar and flour shortages; Briefly: Sousse arrests, procurement rules, plainclothes traffic police; And finally: airport taxi fares.

item.title: Tunis Desk – Saturday 17 October 2026
item.description: Running order: Civil society coalition including the UGTT marches in Tunis; Two thousand and twenty-seven budget, oil prices and a possible supplementary budget; New nine-member ISIE to be appointed by presidential decree; Appeals court upholds four-year sentence against Khayam Turki; Kais Saied in Bizerte for Evacuation Day; Briefly: hadhaer workers, sugar and flour supply, oil sourcing, regional items; And finally: airport taxi fares.
